author: Mark Atwood
text:
ASSESSMENT (2026-08-28): DECOMPOSED. Spec answers the policy (spec/05-routing.md 8.7/8.7.1/8.7.2); implementations are uneven, and the Rust authorization core exists only as UNCOMMITTED in-flight work by another session. No human escalation needed: the spec pins /0, foreign host routes, and delegation semantics.

== WHAT EXISTS ==
1. DAO origin authenticity (8.6) is real in all impls:
   - Rust: DaoOriginValidator (rust/lichen-rpl/src/dao_origin.rs:194) = pinned key + IID binding + Schnorr48; root ingest DaoManager::process_signature_verified_inner (rust/lichen-rpl/src/routing.rs:489) orders admission -> replay classification -> has_exact_origin_target -> sender_is_authorized -> staged apply -> replay-floor commit (routing.rs:573). Rejects land BEFORE route and floor mutation.
   - Python: validate_and_process_dao_wire_at -> target_mismatch / multiple_target (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:869-886).
   - C: sos_origin.c parse/transcript/verify exists (lichen/subsys/lichen/link/sos_origin.c) but is NOT wired into the RPL root path (see gap 3).
2. Wire-profile rejection of non-/128 Targets: Rust envelope parser rejects Target data length != 18 (rust/lichen-rpl/src/message.rs:470-476) -> /0 and broad prefixes die during verify, pre-everything; C semantic parser rejects prefix_len != 128 (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/rpl_dao_process.c:145-148) and E=1 (:184).
3. Foreign host routes: Rust rejects at the policy gate (has_exact_origin_target, routing.rs:633-650: exactly one Target, prefix_len==128, prefix==origin). Python rejects (dao_manager.py:875). C does NOT (gap 3).

== GAPS (children filed) ==
1. C root DAO ingest is FAIL-OPEN: lichen_rpl_dao_manager_process_dao_ex hardcodes authenticated=true (rpl_dao_process.c:735); process_dao never receives the DAO source address (rpl_dao_process.c:583-608), so a foreign /128 host route (target != origin) is accepted and installed. Fix requires API change (thread origin + authenticated through lichen/rpl_routing.h:655,671) and profile-aware rewrite of lichen/tests/rpl_routing/src/main.c fixtures (install_one/process_one at :150-165 advertise foreign targets). Child: project-LICHEN-worker6-d1oh
2. Rust delegation gate is UNCOMMITTED in-flight work in the working tree (routing.rs +137 lines: UnauthorizedPrefixReason, PrefixAuthorizationError, PrefixDelegations keyed by pubkey, MAX_PREFIX_DELEGATIONS=64) and does not compile (E0502 borrow conflict routing.rs:219-224); it is not yet wired into process_signature_verified_inner. Child: project-LICHEN-worker6-d1oi
3. Python has an unwired COSE_Sign1 delegation primitive (python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py, spec 18.8.6: create/verify/scope) and no delegation cache in dao_manager. Child: project-LICHEN-worker6-d1oj
4. Delegation delivery (CoAP POST .well-known/prefix-delegation, COSE_Sign1, delegation_seq, expiry per spec 8.7.2) exists nowhere. Child: project-LICHEN-worker6-d1ok
5. Vectors: no cross-impl allow/deny matrix for DAO prefix authorization. Child: project-LICHEN-worker6-d1ol

== LANDED IN THIS UNIT ==
rust/lichen-rpl/tests/dao_prefix_authorization.rs (new standalone target, fmt+clippy clean): literal 4-row allow/deny matrix at the authed root ingest boundary, validated against HEAD 439c12e041 in a clean worktree (1 passed):
  - self_host_route_allowed -> Ok(Applied), route installed, replay floor committed
  - foreign_host_route_rejected -> Err(RouteRejected), NO route, NO floor (proves pre-mutation ordering)
  - slash_zero_rejected / undelegated_broad_prefix_rejected -> Err(Malformed(InvalidOptionLength)) at wire profile
"Delegated prefix allowed" rows are impossible until the delegation gate lands (children 2-4).

NOTE: rust/lichen-rpl/tests/rpl_route_state_vectors.rs does not compile at HEAD (stale vs the ow1e.111 Ipv6Addr migration: missing Ipv6Addr import, pre-.into() call sites); left alone - owned by that in-progress migration. Deliberately NOT touched: routing.rs (other session's in-flight work).
